headline: Meghmani Organics releases Q2 FY27 financial results

headline: Merck announces receipt of the NCLT Ahmedabad bench amalgamation order
summary: Merck has received the certified copy of the amalgamation order passed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Ahmedabad Bench. This order marks a key regulatory milestone in concluding the company's merger process. Shareholders and investors in the listed entity must note the progression of corporate restructuring. The completion of this legal step brings the merger closer to final execution.
whats_next: Filing of the order with the Registrar of Companies
